title: MEDIA ALERT: Equinix Sets Conference Call for Third-Quarter Results
summary: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Equinix, Inc. (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure…...
body_markdown:
REDWOOD CITY, Calif.


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Equinix, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787458-1&h=1193733725&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.equinix.com%2F&a=Equinix%2C+Inc.) (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure company®, today announced that it will hold its quarterly conference call on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. ET (2:30 p.m. PT). The company will discuss third-quarter results for the period ended September 30, 2026.


To hear the conference call live, please dial 1-517-308-9482 (domestic and international) and reference the passcode: EQIX. A simultaneous live webcast of the call will be available on the[Investor Relations site](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787458-1&h=1526983237&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.equinix.com%2F&a=Investor+Relations+site) . A replay of the call will be available one hour after the call through Thursday, December 31, 2026, by dialing 1-800-814-6745 and entering the passcode: 2026. In addition, the webcast will be available on the[Investor Relations site](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787458-1&h=456694995&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.equinix.com%2Finvestors&a=Investor+Relations+site) (no password required).


**About Equinix**
[Equinix, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787458-1&h=1193733725&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.equinix.com%2F&a=Equinix%2C+Inc.) (Nasdaq: EQIX) shortens the path to boundless connectivity anywhere in the world. Its digital infrastructure, data center footprint and interconnected ecosystems empower innovations that enhance our work, life and planet. Equinix connects economies, countries, organizations and communities, delivering seamless digital experiences and cutting-edge AI—quickly, efficiently and everywhere.
